title: Hardening Soft Information: Evidence on Analyst Integration Costs
abstract: arXiv:2505.12269v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We examine how the cost of transforming qualitative information into precise numerical estimates--a form of integration cost--creates a structural friction in expectations formation. To isolate this integration cost from the costs of information awareness and acquisition, we exploit sell-side analyst reports, in which the same forecaster simultaneously produces textual narratives and numerical forecasts. Because the information underlying the text has already been acquired, any systematic gap between the two outputs can be attributed to integration costs. We document systematic quantification inefficiency: an analyst's textual tone negatively predicts her contemporaneous forecast errors and positively predicts her subsequent numerical revisions, revealing that analysts leave part of their qualitative insights unquantified until further evidence arrives. translated_title: 硬化软信息：关于分析师整合成本的证据
translated_abstract: 我们研究了将定性信息转化为精确数值估计的成本——即一种整合成本——如何在预期形成中制造结构性摩擦。为了将这种整合成本与信息知晓和信息获取的成本分离开来，我们利用了卖方分析师报告，其中同一预测者同时产出文本叙述和数值预测。由于文本背后的信息已经被获取，两种产出之间的任何系统性差距都可以归因于整合成本。我们记录了系统性的量化低效率现象：分析师的文本语调负向预测其同期的预测误差，并正向预测其随后的数值修正，这表明分析师在更多证据到来之前，会将其部分定性洞察保留而不加以量化。与这种整合摩擦的解释相一致，这种低效率……
tldr: 该论文巧妙利用卖方分析师报告中同一预测者同时产出文本叙述与数值预测的设定，首次将定性信息转化为数值估计的“整合成本”从信息知晓和获取成本中分离出来，发现分析师会系统性地延迟量化其部分定性洞察，从而揭示了预期形成过程中的结构性摩擦。
en_tdlr: Exploiting sell-side analyst reports—where the same forecaster simultaneously produces textual narratives and numerical forecasts—this paper isolates the integration cost of converting qualitative information into numerical estimates, documenting systematic quantification inefficiency that reveals a structural friction in expectations formation.
